red_flags.label: Fever with stiff neck or new confusion
Fever in a baby under 3 months
Fever with a rash that does not fade when pressed

rules.reason: Temperature of 40 C or above needs same-day assessment.
Being unable to drink fluids risks dehydration.
Fever in a baby under 1 year needs same-day assessment.
Fever lasting five days or more.
The person rates the illness as severe.
Fever lasting two days or more should be reviewed by a doctor.
Fever after recent travel should be reviewed by a doctor.
The person rates the illness as moderate.

warning_signs: Rash that does not fade when pressed
source_notes: Rules are student-authored from the general principles in public triage guidance (NHS emergency advice, ESI handbook, WHO emergency triage). Source clause references still to be added; NOT clinically validated.
